saadway.description: SaadWay dashboard RPC surface (Principle V: authenticated LAN sessions only; least privilege — strictly the saadway.* object methods, nothing system-wide). Attached to the 'saadway-admin' login via /etc/config/rpcd 'list read saadway'/'list write saadway' (uci-defaults/50-saadway-rpcd). Root sessions map LuCI's own trust path and are not further restricted here.
